## Kill Chain v1.4.0

Windows desktop audio engine — EQ, spatial processing, restoration, analysis, and playback in one workspace.

### Highlights

- **Clarity Engine** — one-knob audio cleaning in Sculptor
- **Deadflat** — flatten your frequency response in Calibration
- **Fire Command** — piano roll upgrades, WAV export, project save, custom drum samples, Sample Deck
- **Tractor Auto-Lock** — hands-free EQ lock when your source changes
- **Visualizer overhaul** — all 8 modes upgraded; Strike is now a musical warzone
- **Scope** — 8192-point float FFT for sharper analysis
- **Boot sequence** — cinematic SYSTEM ARM splash and breach-charge engage sound

### Install

1. Download `Kill-Chain-Setup-1.4.0.exe` below
2. Run the installer (see SmartScreen note in README if Windows blocks it)
3. Launch from Start menu or desktop shortcut

### Requirements

Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JerryKoller/Kill-Chain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
